items.title: Japanese media: Japan's new fiscal-year budget request may exceed 130 trillion yen
items.title_zh: 日媒：日本新财年预算申请额或超130万亿日元
items.summary: Kyodo reported on the 21st that Japan's ministries and agencies are expected to request a combined budget of more than 130 trillion yen for FY2027 (April 2027-March 2028), up sharply from 122 trillion yen this fiscal year (about 159 yen to the dollar).
items.summary_zh: 据日本共同社21日报道，日本政府部门和机构2027财年（2027年4月至2028年3月）预算申请总额预计将超过130万亿日元（1美元约合159日元），相比本财年的122万亿日元显著增加

items.title: Trump announces temporary exemption from ground-beef import tariffs
items.title_zh: 特朗普宣布暂时豁免碎牛肉进口关税
items.summary: On the 21st, President Trump said the US will allow tariff-free imports of up to 300,000 tonnes of ground beef over the next 90 days to lower domestic consumer prices.
items.summary_zh: 美国总统特朗普21日表示，美国将在未来90天内允许免关税进口最多30万吨碎牛肉，以降低国内消费价格

items.summary: The data-center-linked debt market is facing fresh pricing pressure.
items.summary_zh: 数据中心相关债务市场正面临新的定价压力
